answer: Agents grading orchard fruit at a wharf with a prism spectrometer receive subsidies through a trust-flow graph. Approved buyer roots have fixed daily budgets; signed endorsement edges have fixed capacities. A ledger debits used edge capacity and enforces flow conservation across all payouts. Aliases in a cluster cannot draw more than its incoming cut capacity; endorsement cycles create no budget. More subsidy needs scarce endorsements from honest roots. This assumes independent roots that attackers cannot freely create or control.
